predictionQuestion: Why do you think we forget things we have learned? What could help us remember?
transcript: Good morning, everyone. Today I'm going to talk about why we forget, and what we can do about it. I'll cover two points. First, how quickly we forget. Second, two simple ways to remember more.
So, let's start with how quickly we forget. When we learn something new, we often lose a lot of it within a day or two, unless we use it again. This pattern is sometimes called the forgetting curve.

Now, moving on to the solutions. The first solution is review. Looking at new material again after a short time helps it stay in memory. The second solution is retrieval. In other words, test yourself instead of only rereading. For example, cover your notes and try to say the main points.
So, to sum up. We forget new information quickly, but review and self-testing help us remember more.
